hero.title: Fair project assignment for your school.
hero.lede: Wunschplatz imports your students’ project wishes and helps assign them fairly – right in the browser, with no Wunschplatz account. No paper chaos or spreadsheet formulas: imported student data is processed and stored on your device.
hero.ctaHint: Free · No account needed · Open source

how.title: How it works
how.step1Text: Generate a ready-made template for Google Forms or Microsoft Forms from your projects.
how.step2Text: Upload the CSV export of the responses – Wunschplatz detects columns and priorities automatically.
how.step3Text: The solver finds the fairest assignment based on wishes, priorities, and capacities.

features.title: Everything for project week
features.roundsText: Multiple assignment rounds per year – each round keeps its projects, students, and results.
features.blueprintText: A ready-to-paste question template for Google or Microsoft Forms – no retyping.
features.importText: Import responses from Google and Microsoft Forms, including duplicate detection.
features.solverText: The solver assigns by priorities and capacities – transparent and fair.
features.editingText: Adjust assignments manually and export them as an Excel file.
features.offlineText: Imports and calculations run on your device. An internet connection is needed to open or reload the app.

privacy.title: Local processing, clear boundaries
privacy.text: Wunschplatz processes imported data in your browser and does not upload it. If you collect responses through Google Forms or Microsoft Forms, that provider stores and processes the responses before you import them here.
privacy.point1: Imported data is stored locally in the browser
privacy.point3: External forms use the chosen provider’s storage and privacy settings

openSource.text: Wunschplatz is open source and free. The entire code is publicly available – transparency instead of a black box.

footer.ctaTitle: Ready for the next project week?

figure.caption: Example distribution: 248 students, 18 projects, 81 % first wish, nobody left without a place.
